interpretation: On this frozen 12-question subset, neither instruction produced a consistent improvement across metrics and examples. The concise prompt has small mean F1, faithfulness and relevancy gains, but is not shorter on average. The evidence-check prompt is longer, with lower mean F1 and relevancy and a very small mean faithfulness gain. IMEI and bullying-policy cases demonstrate regressions and unsupported additions. The budget-deficit F1 improvement largely reflects wording: the original already covers the supported definition. Some unsupported specifics remain even when the automated faithfulness score is 1.0. Use these scores together with evidence inspection; this assistant review is not a human correctness annotation or evidence of a population-wide effect.
